Subject: Re: internal: Canary gating proposal for KlaraHealth (draft)

Internal note / draft gating plan — assign owners before sending the update to Klara.

Proposed canary profile (daytime slice per Aisha):
- Duration: 7 business days (Jul 26–Aug 2) with progressive ramp at 0.5% → 2% → 5% → 15% → 50% → 100% (final day).
- Telemetry gates (must pass at each stage): 99.7% p99 latency <= 300ms, error rate < 0.2%, memory/cpu anomaly < 10% above baseline.
- Rollback triggers: any sustained p99 spike > 500ms for 30m, error rate > 1% sustained for 15m, or data integrity mismatch on migration checks.
- Acceptance: Tom (Klara Ops) to sign off on day 7 after a 24h observation window.

Dependencies we need to resolve now:
1) Cluster sizing: Monica to confirm GPU reservation and baseline token throughput by Jul 22.
2) Sandbox snapshot: Lauren to chase Klara for read-only export by Jul 24.
3) Runbooks: Jasmine to prepare runbook drafts and a quick rollback play for the rehearsal.

I'll fold this into the MAP and push v1.1 once we have the sizing numbers.

Karthik
